source.title: Novel original Dragonflight output-event export search and branch-wide Looter cohort deduplication

notes: This run recovered no NEW independently measured completed-cast source with per-output zero/1/2+ bins. Search concentrated on original export/log/spreadsheet leads rather than recopying known Reddit ore studies, and checked six named processing subjects across web, Blizzard, GitHub and Wowhead. Source-reported Looter item IDs 202499, 202529, 202535, 202467 and 202484 were inspected, but their cohort observations are already present in branch Dragonflight evidence (202535 in 2026-11-15T0133, 202499 in 2026-11-16T0853, 202529/202467/202484 in 2026-11-17 current branch). Do NOT import duplicate cumulative item snapshots. No novel P(hit), totalQuantity, castsWithDrop, refund adjustment, zero histogram or runtime gold valuation inferred. Gaps remain: Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic rank-specific per-event prospect records and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling event ledgers.
lookingFor: NEW original Dragonflight Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic Ore prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling cast-by-cast histograms, exact rank IDs, character skill/spec/Resourcefulness refunds, and nonduplicate gear disenchant source cohorts
